question.text: STT on sale of UNLISTED equity shares/business trust units under an IPO is:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.3.3, STT on IPO sale of unlisted equity/business trust units = 0.2%. **The Trap:** Other rates apply to different transactions. **Cross-Exam Context:** Applies specifically to offer-for-sale IPOs. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Factor 0.2% into IPO exit strategy cost for pre-IPO Cat III AIF positions.
